extract.title: Extract
extract.description: Rule-based extraction of vendor address, tax, bank, company code, and purchasing org data. Auto-exclude blocked or flagged vendors.

useCaseShowcase.ctaText: Read the full technical walkthrough of this BP migration scenario.

fuzzyDuplicateShowcase.scenarioTitle: Fuzzy Duplicate Detection & Cleansing — SAP Master Data
fuzzyDuplicateShowcase.scenarioDescription: 120,000+ material master records across multiple plants and storage locations, scanned with AI-powered fuzzy matching to detect near-duplicates — clustered, reviewed, and cleansed across both master and transactional data.
fuzzyDuplicateShowcase.beforeTitle: Before — Fuzzy Duplicates in Master Data
fuzzyDuplicateShowcase.beforeCaption: Same materials created with slight variations in description, abbreviation, and formatting — causing duplicate POs, inflated stock, and mismatched pricing.
fuzzyDuplicateShowcase.afterCaption: Golden records retained, duplicates merged. All linked sales orders & purchase orders automatically re-pointed to the surviving record.

scan.title: Scan
scan.description: Extract material master records from SAP tables (MARA, MAKT, MARC). Normalize descriptions, remove noise characters, and tokenize for comparison.

match.title: Match
match.description: Apply fuzzy algorithms — Levenshtein distance, Jaro-Winkler, and phonetic encoding — to score similarity across description, material group, and UoM.

cluster.title: Cluster
cluster.description: Group matched records into duplicate clusters with confidence scores. Flag high-confidence auto-merge candidates and route borderline cases for review.

review.title: Review
review.description: Data stewards review clusters via approval workflow. Accept, reject, or override merge decisions. Full audit trail for every action taken.

cleanse.title: Cleanse
cleanse.description: Merge duplicates into golden records. Auto-update sales orders, purchase orders, and inventory docs to reference the surviving master record.

insights.subtitle: Insights from the Business Core Solutions team on data quality, SAP transformation, and the future of enterprise AI.

q1.question: What is deKorvai?
q1.answer: deKorvai is a unified data integrity and orchestration platform combining data quality profiling, ETL, data masking (scrambling), and agentic AI. It's used for test data management, data quality governance, system consolidation, and SAP S/4HANA migration.

q2.question: What is data masking (scrambling)?
q2.answer: Data masking replaces sensitive production values with realistic substitutes so data stays usable for testing while the originals can't be recovered. deKorvai preserves format and referential integrity across systems.

q3.question: Does deKorvai replace the SAP Migration Cockpit (DMC)?
q3.answer: No — deKorvai feeds DMC. It extracts, profiles, transforms, and masks data, then loads clean records into DMC staging tables, achieving high first-pass rates.

q4.question: What SAP migration approaches does deKorvai support?
q4.answer: Greenfield, Brownfield, and Bluefield (selective data transition), plus GROW, regional roll-outs, and system consolidation.

q5.question: Is deKorvai compliant for test environments?
q5.answer: Yes. Field-level masking with predefined profiles supports GDPR, HIPAA, and SOX, keeping non-production data realistic but non-identifiable.

q6.question: How is deKorvai different from separate DQ, ETL, and masking tools?
q6.answer: It unifies all three plus agentic AI in one platform — removing hand-offs between tools that cause most migration data failures.
